title: AO/415/2018 of ASSISTANT GENERAL MANAGER UTTARAKHAND TRANSPORT CORPORATION PITHORAGARH Vs SMT. SARASWATI DEVI

paras.text:
MCC No.1600 of 2018
CLMA No.19905 of 2018
In
AO No.415 of 2018
Honíble Lok Pal Singh, J.
 Mr. Ashish Joshi, Advocate for the
appellant.
 This recall application (MCC
No.1600 of 2018) along with delay
condonation application (CLMA
No.19905 of 2018) has moved to recall
the order dated 25.10.2018 whereby the
appeal has been dismissed for not curing
the defects despite time granted to the
appellant.
 There is a delay of some 10 days in
filing the recall application. Reason
shown for delay is that on 25.10.2018
itself the counsel applied for certified
copy which was made available to him
on 31.10.2018; thereafter, the order was
sent to the department; and the
department vide letter dated 07.12.2018
requested the counsel to file recall
application. It is thereafter that the recall
application has been filed.
 On the recall application, the
appellant has stated that at the time of
filing the appeal the statutory amount
could not be deposited, as bank draft
was not received from the department
and thus the appeal was listed before the
Registrar Judicial. Thereafter, the matter
was listed before the Court. On
25.10.2018, when the case was
dismissed, the counsel for the appellant
was out of station due to death of his
colleague and the counsel who was
holding the brief could not inform the
Court that the bank draft of statutory
amount has been received.

Heard and perused the applications.
 Order dated 25.10.2018 was passed
in presence of counsel. Before that, the
appeal was listed several times before the
Registrar Judicial viz. on 08.10.2018,
11.10.2018, 22.10.2018 and 24.10.2018,
but neither there was any representation
for the appellant nor defect was removed
by the appellant. Hence, the matter was
placed before the Court.
 There was dereliction of duty on the
part of the appellant itself as even after
providing several opportunities, he was
not willing to remove the defect, and as
such this Court observed in its order
that the appellant is not interested to
remove the defect and that it is wastage
of valuable time of Court and accordingly
dismissed the appeal.
 I do not find any plausible
explanation so as to condone the delay
or to recall the order dated 25.10.2018.
That apart, this Court does not find any
merit in the appeal also.
 Delay condonation application as
well as recall application is accordingly
dismissed.
